# Behavioural medicine – where behaviour, psychology and health meet

[The Swedish Society of Behavioural Medicine (Svensk Beteendemedicinsk Förening, SBF) is an interdisciplinary network for researchers and clinicians working on how behavioural, psychological and social factors influence health and illness.]{.lead}

[Become a member](membership.qmd){.btn-sbf} [Upcoming lunch talks](lunch-talks.qmd){.btn-sbf .btn-outline}
:::
